en.title: GPS for Autonomous Driving — Max 2 Turns
en.description:
In a grid with obstacles, determine whether there is a path from Q to W with at most two turns. The vehicle can only move up, down, left or right; each change of moving direction counts as one turn.

This site's input format and constraints are given below.
en.input: The first line contains b p, followed by b lines of p characters each (separated by spaces): o is open ground, x is an obstacle, Q is the start and W is the destination. This site's ranges: 1≤b,p≤1000; Q/W each appear exactly once.
en.output: Output DRIVE! if W is reachable, otherwise output DON'T DRIVE!.
en.explanation: If a solution exists, there is a simple path that does not repeat cells; BFS on the (row,column,direction,turns) state graph visits at most 12bp states.
hints: If a solution exists, there is a simple path that does not repeat cells; BFS on the (row,column,direction,turns) state graph visits at most 12bp states.
